commands.author: jesse-merhi

target.title: Add native Signal reply quotes
target.body:
## Summary

Signal auto-replies now preserve native Signal quote context when OpenClaw responds to the inbound Signal message that triggered the turn. The Signal plugin carries the inbound message timestamp, author, and body through reply delivery, sends quote metadata to native `signal-cli`/json-rpc, and maps the same quote fields to the Signal REST container send API. If quote metadata is missing, explicitly disabled, aimed at a different reply target, or rejected by the backend, OpenClaw falls back to a normal Signal message instead of dropping the reply.

## What Changed

- Inbound Signal handling records the inbound timestamp as the current reply target and carries native quote context into reply delivery.
- Signal text and media auto-replies include `replyToId`, `replyToAuthor`, and `replyToBody` only when they match the triggering inbound message.
- `replyToCurrent: false`, mismatched explicit reply targets, `replyToMode: off`, and single-message `batched` mode suppress native quote metadata for implicit replies.
- `replyToMode: first` consumes native quote metadata only for the first normal implicit reply; `replyToMode: all` preserves it across each emitted reply chunk.
- Explicit current-message replies can still quote the current message even when implicit reply mode is off.
- Native sends retry without quote metadata when Signal rejects quote fields, including unrecognized quote-field errors, while receipts preserve `replyToId` and record whether native quote send used `sent` or `fallback` status.
- Signal REST container mode translates quote metadata to `/v2/send` snake_case fields and strips `uuid:` prefixes from quote authors for the container API.
- Signal config now accepts `replyToMode` and direct/group `replyToModeByChatType` at channel and account scope, with account values taking precedence over channel chat-type overrides.
- Signal approval-reaction hint registration now handles structured approval payload delivery and icon-prefixed approval prompt headers without relying on temporary local setup.
- Signal docs describe native quote behavior, fallback, and the new reply-to config fields.

## Proof

Behavioral proof:

- Focused automated coverage proves native quote send, fallback retry, receipt metadata, REST container quote fields, UUID author normalization, inbound context wiring, text replies, media replies, mismatched reply-target suppression, `replyToCurrent: false`, explicit current-message quoting, `replyToMode` chat/account precedence, single-use quote consumption, all-mode multi-chunk quoting, approval-reaction registration, and config schema acceptance/rejection.
- Live Signal proof used a local Signal REST/json-rpc linked device. A non-self inbound event in the Testing realm group was captured, the feature-branch send path sent one quoted proof reply with `replyToId`, `replyToAuthor`, and `replyToBody`, Signal accepted the send with `deliveredMessageIdPresent=true`, and Jesse visually confirmed the reply appeared in Signal.

Manual proof gaps and follow-up risks:

- The live proof covers group native quote delivery. Basic Signal DM reply behavior is already working in this linked setup, but this closeout did not add a fresh manual DM native-quote proof.
- No further live Signal messages were sent after the confirmed Testing realm proof.
- Temporary local Signal REST/container config fixes used to complete live proof are not product proof and are not part of this PR.
- Signal group id normalization and Signal mention matching remain separate follow-up risks outside this PR.

Screenshots are not included because this is a backend channel transport change with no OpenClaw-rendered UI surface. The human-visible proof is the live Signal confirmation above.

## Verification

Reviewer-checkable behavior:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/signal/src/send.test.ts extensions/signal/src/client-container.test.ts extensions/signal/src/core.test.ts extensions/signal/src/monitor.tool-result.sends-tool-summaries-responseprefix.test.ts extensions/signal/src/monitor/event-handler.inbound-context.test.ts extensions/signal/src/monitor.approval-reply-delivery.test.ts src/config/config.allowlist-requires-allowfrom.test.ts` passed after the final fixes: 2 Vitest shards, 7 files, 193 tests.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.extensions.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/review-signal-native-reply-final-extensions.tsbuildinfo` passed.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.extensions.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/review-signal-native-reply-final-extensions-test.tsbuildinfo` passed.
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/review-signal-native-reply-final-core.tsbuildinfo` passed.
- `pnpm format -- <20 touched files>` passed before the final commit.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD && git diff --check` passed.
- Proof-pack net diff at `65dc1fb62658` found 20 changed files and no branch-only churn with no net diff.
- Required review workflow completed on the final overlay: native Phase 1 reached 3/3 clean and independent cold Phase 2 reached 3/3 clean on the same final target, with no open findings recorded.
- Earlier targeted remote changed gate `tbx_01kwaxm04x06337mak6sxmhe8v` passed `OPENCLAW_CHECK_CHANGED_REMOTE_CHILD=1 OPENCLAW_CHANGED_LANES_RAW_SYNC=1 corepack pnpm check:changed` on the then-current Signal diff; this branch has since had the final reviewed overlay committed and pushed.
